ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.eLogix_Bypass_Validation_Rules), AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Inspection Passed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Inspection Failed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Restocked")), OR(ISBLANK(Inspection_Completed_Date__c), ISBLANK(Inspection_Notes__c)) ) )
